200.description:
Address rows of one source, segment = source, pinned to one job. Whole-file mode (output at most 8 MiB): downloads `source.geojson.gz` from v2.openaddresses.io (302 to the presigned object URL), gunzips the line-delimited GeoJSON and pages by line offset; every page re-reads the file and compares its ETag with the one pinned in the cursor. Tile mode (larger outputs with PMTiles): requires `bbox`; reads the job's `source.pmtiles` with Range requests (header, directories, one z14 tile per page) and decodes the `data` layer, which tippecanoe wrote without drops at z14. Handoff mode (larger outputs without PMTiles): returns no rows and the file URL, size and ETag in `handoff`. The cursor pins job id and ETag, so a weekly run does not break a walk; a `latest_job` that differs from the pinned job is reported in `newer_job`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `content_hash` | string |  |
| `count` | number |  |
| `data_id` | number |  |
| `handoff` | object | Set in `handoff` mode: the output is larger than the whole-file limit and the job has no PMTiles, so the downstream must fetch the file itself. |
| `job_id` | number |  |
| `layer` | string |  |
| `licence` | object | The job's licence as OpenAddresses records it, normalised; null when the job carries `license: false`. |
| `mode` | string |  |
| `newer_job` | number | A later successful job for this source, when the walk is pinned to an older one; null otherwise. |
| `next_cursor` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `page` | object |  |
| `publication_id` | string |  |
| `records` | object[] |  |
| `retrieved_at` | string | RFC 3339 UTC time of the upstream read. |
| `source` | string |  |
| `source_url` | string | The OpenAddresses URL this answer was read from (never a presigned URL). |
| `total_count` | number | Row count of the whole job output. |
